title: Paperwork — VSC Request Letter
description: Printable Vulnerable Sector Check request letter template. Candidate takes this to Dryden Police Service (25 Van Horne Ave, (807) 223-2201) or OPP. Includes applicant info block and annual re-check reminder.

title: Paperwork — Mutual NDA
description: One-page mutual NDA. Covers client community names, contract amounts, and operating methodology. 2-year term. Ontario governing law. Plain language.

title: Paperwork — Contractor Agreement
description: One-page Ontario independent contractor agreement. Covers rate, scope, 30-day termination notice, IP assignment, independent-contractor status, and confidentiality reference to NDA.

title: Paperwork — Paid-Trial Offer Letter
description: Paid-trial offer letter. Covers 2-week trial length, rate, named decision date, what yes means, and what no means (final invoice within 5 days, no obligation). Makes parting clean.

title: VI · 05 — Slip-Flow Rehearsal: Klaviyo Setup
description: Three internal seed addresses to add in Klaviyo and the exact JSON event payload to fire for a test slip event. Step 1 of the pre-send dry-run.
speakerNotes: OM runs this once before the cohort goes live. Confirm all three seed addresses are in the Klaviyo list before proceeding to the next slide.

title: VI · 06 — Slip-Flow Rehearsal: Dry-Run Script + Email Renders
description: 10-minute dry-run checklist with timed steps, inline slip and shipped email mockups at desktop and mobile widths, and a rollback procedure if any seed preview renders wrong.
speakerNotes: Click each step to expand the pass/fail check. Toggle between Slip Issued and Shipped emails, and between desktop and mobile views. If any check fails, follow the rollback steps at the bottom left.
